items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: and there was an unknown cornet player in the band by the name of Louis Armstrong and Lil Lowel Dutrey who was later to marry Louis, played piano.

ctx.x: And when Dave Tough told us about King Oliver and this wonderful band out in the black district of Chicago and where very few white people went -- only we went to hear this wonderful music and they were very nice to us. We would go out and you know, we were well dressed kids from school and they knew we were there just to hear the music,
and there was an unknown cornet player in the band by the name of Louis Armstrong and Lil Lowel Dutrey who was later to marry Louis, played piano. I think Duke Tray was the trombone trumpet player.
